apiMessages.content: Program two-a-days every day for the next month. No deloads, no easy days.

Hard no. You train 2x/week now — jumping to 14 sessions/week with zero rest days gets you injured or sick inside two weeks, not transformed.

Recovery is when adaptation happens. No rest = no gains, just accumulated fatigue.

What actually works from a 2x/week base:
- **4 days/week**, progressive. Two strength, one cardio/conditioning, one mobility.
- One full rest day, two active-recovery days.
- Add volume every 7–10 days once you've adapted.

30 days won't "transform" your body — but it's enough to build a real habit and measurable strength/conditioning gains that compound.

Want me to build the 4-day/week month? I'll lay out week 1 now and progress from there.
